Judge files: all five judge.toml (gates/constraints, gates/render, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) carry 'judge = "claude-code"' at line 2 (matches REWARDKIT_JUDGE), and their header up to [scoring] is byte-identical to the template's; grep for 'model *=|reasoning|temperature' across tests/**/*.toml returns nothing, so no judge.toml names a model. test.sh is byte-identical to the template, refuses (zero reward, line 63-65) when REWARDKIT_JUDGE/MODEL are unset, and invokes rewardkit (line 207) with no model override, so the model comes only from [verifier.env].
